name: phd-outside-incomplete
description: Policy review round 3, P3-ac-4-1 (DGS 2026-10-05: 'Apply the suggested handling. For the question at the end: an outside I should be held for DGS review'). A Ph.D. student entering Fall 2026 holds a completed UMass Amherst master's whose transcript shows COMPSCI 589 graded I in Spring 2026. Until 2026-10-05 the app put it on Notre Dame's Academic Code §4.4 clock — 'complete the work by about 2026-07-14 … or it becomes an F', then 'became an F unless the Graduate School extended it' — although §4.4 governs Notre Dame's own courses. Now an outside Incomplete gets no Notre Dame date and is held for the DGS until it is graded: with no final grade it cannot show the B §5.2 requires.

detailIncludes: Graded I (Incomplete) at University of Massachusetts Amherst — no final grade yet, so it cannot show the B that §5.2 requires
